title: Learning the Topic, Not the Language: How LLMs Classify Online Immigration Discourse Across Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Correlating the classification accuracy of immigration-related tweets across 13 different languages with the estimated proportion of each language present in the model's pretraining corpus to measure English-centric performance disparities.

Comparing the classification accuracy of human-annotated original non-English tweets against their machine-translated English counterparts, controlling for translation quality, to measure semantic loss and performance degradation.
